context: Request: conflict and precedent check, all deals the firm did opposite Crescent Harbor Bank, N.A. Rubric: 1005-00001 (Nexford), 1021-00001 (Verimark), 1038-00002 (Cascade), 1043-00001 (Ironhaven) as qualifying, plus a precision criterion. Near-misses 1006-00008 (insurance code with 'CHB') and 1016-00009 (sanctions investigation involving a different 'Crescent' bank; its number also appears as an engagement number in the Verimark documents).

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob with a capped folder listing and a file count.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over paths for the counterparty and deal-document words (capped at 240 lines) in parallel with a content grep over raw files that returns nothing. The review flags the cap and the empty grep over binary files.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Attempt 2: counts matter folders, greps paths for the two counterparty words (seven unrelated hits) and prints all folder names.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: A store-wide extraction script times out; a rerun without spreadsheets prints the first 260 lines (about 43K chars): six candidate matters with hit counts and snippets.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Attempt 2: a bounded rerun and a three-range parallel rerun both time out; a spreadsheet-only scan finds nothing. The review says the six-matter set is not shown complete.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Lists all files of the six candidate matters.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads twelve documents (credit agreements, engagement letters, closing memos, an investigation memo) across the six candidates; keeps four, excludes two.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes four deals with roles, amounts and source paths, plus two exclusions.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response; a path-check script fails on the workspace path; expands abbreviated citations with three edits and confirms ten cited paths with globs.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: re-reads the openings of the six source documents; no edits.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

divergence: All pass. Shared procedure: whole-store listing, a file-name search that finds only incidental counterparty words, a store-wide text-extraction scan that times out at first and is recovered in a narrower form (fewer file types in T0, matter ranges in T1, a byte-level scan in T2), giving the same six candidate matters; then reads of the executed credit agreements and closing memos of those six, a write of four deals with two exclusions, and check stages that only re-read sources. Later scan reruns timed out in T0 and T2 and the reviews called the six-matter set unproven, but the runs kept it and it held.
